# POST /api/v1/admin/cron/{task}

Triggers a cron task to run immediately

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer (token with AccessTokenScopeCategoryAdmin) · **ID:** `ep-111`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| task | path | string | True |

**Headers:** `Authorization`

## Response

**204** — empty

- **404** — Task name not found in registered tasks

## Workflow

| Step | Module | Component | Type | Details |
|------|--------|-----------|------|---------|
| 1 | [routers](../modules/routers.md) | admin.PostCronTask | controller ⏳ | Get task name from path param; Call cron.GetTask(name); If nil, return 404; Call task.Run(); Log trace message |
| 2 | [services](../modules/services.md) | cron.Task.Run | service ⏳ | Acquire global lock for task; Increment ExecTimes; Run task function in shutdown context; On error: set status to error/cancelled, create system notice; On success: set status to finished |

### Datastore Operations

| Store | Type | Operation | Description |
|-------|------|-----------|-------------|
| [notice](../datastores/databases.md#notice) | database | INSERT | Create notice on task completion (async) |

## Business Rules

| Rule | Category | Condition |
|------|----------|-----------|
| All endpoints require site admin privilege (reqSiteAdmin middleware) | authorization | User must be site admin |
| Cron task.Run() executes asynchronously with global lock | business_logic | Task triggered |

### Error Paths

- **Task name not found** → admin.PostCronTask → 404

## 🛡️ Resiliency

**Risk Level:** low

| Pattern | Status | Severity | Detail |
|---------|--------|----------|--------|
| idempotency | ✅ configured | low | Global lock prevents concurrent execution of same task; safe to retry |

**Cascading failure risk:** Task failure is isolated; creates notice but doesn't affect API response

**Graceful degradation:** Task runs async; API returns 204 immediately regardless of task outcome
